context.transcript:
I'll be conducting a refresher training for all certified forklift operators in the warehouse next week, but I need to make you aware of a few things now.
It's come to my attention that only the crew working the morning shift has been completing the forklift inspection checklist.
However, the forklifts must be inspected at the... beginning of every eight-hour shift.
That's three times a day.
Also, if you notice anything that isn't functioning properly, please don't forget to document it.
We have a logbook on the wall over there for this purpose.
context.transcript_translation:
我下周将在仓库为所有认证的叉车操作员进行一次复习培训，但现在需要提醒你几件事。
我的注意是只有上早班的员工完成了叉车检查清单。
然而，叉车必须在...每个八小时轮班开始时进行检查。
那是每天三次。
另外，如果你注意到任何功能不正常的地方，请不要忘记记录下来。
我们在那面墙上有本日志册用于此目的。
